name: CyberSathi - OpenPhish Feed Sync
sanitized: No secrets present. Credential IDs removed (names kept).
description: Scheduled sync of the OpenPhish community feed into the CyberSathi indicator store, every 12 hours.

parameters.content:
## OpenPhish feed sync
Runs every 12 hours, matching the OpenPhish community feed refresh interval. Stores the feed in the local indicator table through the internal API. The feed is never queried per request. The internal endpoint /internal/feeds/openphish must exist in the API before this workflow is activated.
